name: Milind Patel
title: Senior Full-Stack Developer & Web Development Manager
summary: Senior full-stack developer and web development manager with 10+ years of experience building complex, high-availability web systems with C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular, React, and SQL Server on Azure and AWS. Builds Claude-powered AI agents in Python that cut a recurring engineering task from ~2 weeks to about 1 day. Architects and maintains 8 applications and 12 API integrations, has helped pass 4 consecutive annual PCI DSS audits, leads a team of 5 developers, and has delivered an estimated $60K+ in annual savings.

experience.title: Web Development Manager
bullets: Designed Claude-powered AI agents in Python, now used across the team, for impact analysis, legacy-code refactoring, test generation, and audit-evidence preparation — cutting a recurring monthly task from ~2 weeks to about 1 day (~90% faster) and saving ~850 engineering hours (~$45K) a year.
Build and maintain Python and Go services and APIs alongside the .NET estate, plus Python automation scripts and Go command-line utilities and Kubernetes deployment tooling used by the team.

Architect, maintain, and develop 8 applications (5 customer-facing, 3 internal) and 12 API integrations — Angular and React front ends, ASP.NET Core and ASP.NET Framework back ends, SQL Server, and Magento.
Set up Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for 4 Azure App Service applications in 3 days, replacing 2–4-hour manual releases and saving ~170 engineering hours (~$9K) a year across 8–12 monthly releases.
Optimized Azure and AWS resources across the application estate, cutting cloud spend by over $10K a year.

Built location and address features with the Google Maps JavaScript and Geocoding APIs, caching results within Google's 30-day limit to cut API cost, and integrated payment token providers as in-scope PCI DSS components.

Designed an ASP.NET Core Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) integration layer with retry, timeout, and circuit-breaker policies, and lead the incremental modernization of legacy ASP.NET Framework applications to ASP.NET Core.

Run containerized ASP.NET Core services on Kubernetes behind load balancers (health probes, Horizontal Pod Autoscaler), and troubleshoot production issues across application, database, and network layers with Application Insights.

Own PCI DSS v4.0.1 compliance across the Magento, .NET, and React applications — remediating OWASP Top 10 findings and compiling audit evidence — passing 4 consecutive annual audits through the moves from v3.2.1 to v4.0 and v4.0.1.
Lead a team of 5 developers (3 in-house, 2 vendor) through design and PR reviews, sprint planning with Product, and vendor and security assessments.

experience.title: Lead Developer
bullets: Developed full-stack features across Rexall's applications with Angular 12, React 18, ASP.NET Core, and ASP.NET Framework, including RESTful APIs and third-party integrations.
Resolved database bottlenecks by rewriting complex T-SQL stored procedures, adding indexes, and analyzing execution plans, speeding up page loads and long-running reports.
Remediated PCI DSS audit and vulnerability-scan findings across the Magento, ASP.NET, and React applications and prepared audit evidence, with every annual audit passed.
Owned code merges, releases, and patches across multiple ASP.NET applications, maintained Azure DevOps pipelines, and provisioned Azure and AWS components with the operations and networking teams.

experience.title: .NET Developer
bullets: Designed and developed full-stack web applications with Angular 11 and .NET 5 Web APIs in an Agile team.
Built an event-driven RabbitMQ integration with message consumers and scheduled SQL jobs, decoupling upstream systems from reporting workloads.
Implemented system-wide audit logging with SQL triggers and stored procedures, and extended Kendo UI for Angular components.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Translated user stories into automated process flows on the DST AWD BPM platform with Product Owners and Scrum Masters.
Built document-filtering automation with XML logic and ASG Mobius Document Direct, and ASP.NET C# interfaces for internal applications.
Built reusable SSIS ETL packages and parameterized stored procedures loading flat-file, Excel, and XML data into SQL Server.

experience.title: Software Developer
bullets: Built Angular front ends on ASP.NET Core Web APIs, and designed, built, and tested IBM Business Process Manager 8.5 process definitions from business requirements.

experience.title: Senior Software Developer
bullets: Architected and built a multi-module School ERP platform on ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core Web API, Angular, and SQL Server that automated school back-office workflows.
Owned client requirements, estimation, and delivery tracking, and mentored junior developers through code reviews.
